_what: The one page list: every page of every brand, its versions and its tests. Read and written by pages.py; plan in page-naming-owner.md. Funnels and the store are places; a page is one step in a place's sequence (landing, cart, checkout, post-purchase).
_id_rule: <brand>_<place>_<page> — place = a funnel id, store, or a place recorded below; page read off the address. Never coined, reused or re-pointed.
_test_fields: Test entries use the funnel repos' pv-tests.json names; their status (draft|live|ended) is kept as `state` (builder card rule 5).
